title: Resolution urging Albany to raise the tax credit for defibrillators
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, A.6811, which would raise the state tax credit for purchasing automated external defibrillators from $500 to $1,000 per unit. The change would apply to taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2026. Supporters say the current credit, unchanged since 2001, no longer offsets the $1,200 to $3,000 cost of a modern AED.
